overview: Django is a high-level Python web framework for building secure, scalable web applications quickly.
description:
Django is an open-source, high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It ships with an ORM, authentication, an admin interface, and built-in protection against common web vulnerabilities.

This package deploys a production-style Django stack: Gunicorn on Python 3.13, PostgreSQL 17, and a named volume for the application code. On first start it creates a default Django project so the admin interface is reachable, and you can then replace it with your own code.

Typical use cases include content sites, internal tools, REST APIs, and data-driven web applications.
